SECOND UK CONFIRMATION OF THE PREP-YEAR MECHANIC, AND A DIRECT-ENTRY REFUSAL. Cambridge lists accepted qualifications by country in a dropdown of 190+ countries and regions; AZERBAIJAN IS NOT LISTED. The page states: 'If your country/region is not listed, it is likely that your local/national qualifications are not accepted.' The alternatives it names as acceptable are A Levels, the International Baccalaureate, five or more Advanced Placement tests at score 5, and 'first year of undergraduate study outside the UK' -- which is the qualification recorded in entry_qualification_accepted here. Because the attestat is not an accepted qualification, no row claims direct entry on it. English is required for applicants not from a majority English speaking country as defined by the UK Home Office, but the IELTS and TOEFL minima are on a separate page that was not read, so language_test and language_minimum_score are left blank.
